What lives here

The apex site, which is the one this directory is part of. Worth noting that `https://frenzypenguin.media` works and `www.frenzypenguin.media` does not, and that nine records in this zone are broken solely because of the second one.

The apex https://frenzypenguin.media serves the same site and DOES have a certificate. Only the www name is broken.
